title: Pellam cheque deposit flow
brief: I'm a product engineer at Pellam Cooperative Bank, and the compliance office has asked for a printed page, for the binder given to new engineers, that explains what happens when a member deposits a cheque with the phone camera. The page is dated 2026-10-08. Under "Deposit sequence" show the exchange between six parties, named exactly: Member App, Deposit Service, Image Checker, Fraud Screen, Ledger, Notifier. In order: Member App to Deposit Service "submit front and back images"; Deposit Service to Image Checker "read amount and account"; Image Checker to Deposit Service "amount 1200.00, confidence 0.97"; Deposit Service to Fraud Screen "score deposit"; Fraud Screen to Deposit Service "risk 12 of 100"; Deposit Service to Ledger "post pending credit"; Ledger to Deposit Service "posted, ref LD-55021"; Deposit Service to Notifier "send received notice"; Notifier to Member App "push, deposit received"; Deposit Service to Ledger "release hold after 1 business day". Under "Hold rules" give a table of deposit amount and hold: up to 500 dollars, no hold; over 500 up to 2500 dollars, 1 business day; over 2500 dollars, 3 business days. Under "Safeguards": a risk score above 70 sends the deposit to manual review instead of posting, cheque images are deleted after 45 days, and a confidence below 0.90 asks the member to retake the photo. Make the 70 threshold impossible to miss.

edit.request: Add a seventh party named Audit Log, and after the Ledger replies "posted, ref LD-55021" have Deposit Service send Audit Log "record posting". Also raise the manual review threshold from 70 to 75.
